preflightNotes: Official Playground streaming duplicated response text; those outputs were excluded from model scores.
A first direct-API connection failed; the report includes an allowance for unknown usage.
Initial 30B thinking-mode probing and a truncated response are preserved in ignored raw reports and included in returned-call usage.
conclusion: Qwen3.8-27B remains the strongest single-turn result on this narrow sample. A two-turn review fixed its unrelated-line control but the complex chorus review timed out. GPT-OSS-120B and Nemotron-3-120B still mis-map real passages; self-review did not consistently improve them. No model has passed an automatic-write acceptance gate.
